Not shipped: the decoders for compressed models (Draco, KTX2/Basis, Meshopt). model-viewer fetches them from
www.gstatic.com only when a model needs them; an ordinary GLB makes no request to another address.
The bundle names one more address: its default for lottieLoaderLocation is
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.149.0/examples/jsm/loaders/LottieLoader.js. It is used only for Lottie textures set
through the API, never for a GLB. public/nodes/preview.js sets lottieLoaderLocation to a path of the app before the
bundle starts, so even that case makes no request to a foreign address.

Loaded on demand by public/nodes/preview.js (the first time a 3D result is shown), not on every page load.
It is not a dependency in package.json. To update: download the new tarball, compare its integrity with the
registry, replace the two files and this note.
